title: Builder Signals · 2026-07-10
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 40 条 X 动态、1 集播客、3 篇博客；本站精选 15 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
featured.summaryEn: Claude Code shipped a `/checkup` command that productizes the chore of maintaining your own agent config. Running it does seven things: clean up unused skills/MCPs/plugins to save context, dedup local CLAUDE.md against the checked-in version, break up a bloated root CLAUDE.md into nested files + skills, turn off slow hooks, update to the latest version, enable auto mode by default, and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. It confirms before making any changes. For teams living in Claude Code, this tur…
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 上线了 `/checkup` 命令，这是把「维护自己的 agent 配置」这件事产品化的一步。跑一次 `/checkup` 会做七件事：清理没在用的 skill / MCP / 插件来省 context、把本地 CLAUDE.md 和 checked-in 版本去重、把臃肿的根 CLAUDE.md 拆成嵌套的 CLAUDE.md + skills、关掉拖慢速度的 hook、自动升级到最新版、默认开启 auto mode、预批准那些频繁被拒的只读命令。所有改动前都会先跟你确认。对于长期用 Claude Code 的团队，这本质上是把「配置卫生」从人工苦活变成一键操作——context 越用越乱是所有 agent 用户的通病，这个思路值得关注。

featured.title: Zara Zhang · Follow Builders 作者、独立开发者
featured.summaryEn: Zara raised an observation every enterprise-AI person should chew on. She talked to a super agent-pilled founder who bought Codex Max for the whole team; nearly all work now happens by talking to Codex all day. The side effect: people stopped talking to each other. Meetings cancelled, collaboration minimal, team culture worse. Her point: so much enterprise AI usage is single-player now — what do we sacrifice when everyone talks to their agent instead of each other? The path forward isn't just human-human or human-…
featured.insightZh: Zara 这周抛出一个值得每个做企业 AI 的人思考的观察。她聊了一位「极度 agent 化」的创始人——给全团队买了 Codex Max，几乎所有活都靠整天跟自己的 Codex 对话完成。副作用是：人和人之间不说话了。会议取消了、协作降到最低、团队文化变差了。她的判断是：现在大量企业 AI 使用是「单人游戏」（single-player），当团队成员都跟各自的 agent 对话而不是彼此对话时，我们到底牺牲了什么？她提出方向——要超越「人-人协作」，也要超越「人-agent 协作」，走向「人-人-agent 协作」。另外她也吐槽 Codex 前端设计能力太弱，是她没法更频繁用它的唯一原因。

featured.title: How a Writer Uses AI Without Losing His Voice（嘉宾 Greg，主持 Dan Shipper）
featured.summaryEn: A writer with technology in his DNA rebuilt Quicken and Campaign Monitor via vibe coding — but keeps a separate laptop for writing that "can't do anything interesting," because AI is meant to feed the creative work, not replace the most valuable part of himself. Guest Greg starts each day without touching the internet or his phone — he feels a "chemical shift" the moment he does, blocking deep focus. So he built physical barriers: a writing-only laptop that can't do anything fun. On vibe coding he's aggressive: he rebuilt Quicken and Campaign Monitor (which was charging him ~$67K/year, counting total not unique emails). He uses Python, avoids React/Next, because he doesn't want to be a sysadmin — software "should just work." The key mindset: building tools that help him write and publish in new ways feeds back into wanting to write more. The deeper shift he and Dan discussed: "can you b…
featured.insightZh: 一个把技术刻进 DNA 的作家，用 vibe coding 给自己「重造」了 Quicken 和 Campaign Monitor，但他给写作留了一台「什么有趣的事都干不了」的笔记本——AI 是用来喂养创作的，不是用来取代那个「最有价值的自己」的。 嘉宾 Greg 是个作家兼技术玩家。他的一天从「不碰互联网、不看手机」开始——他说一旦碰手机就会感到「化学层面的转变」，进不去深度思考的状态。所以他专门弄了一台只能写作、什么有趣的事都干不了的笔记本，用物理屏障保护那个「最有价值的自己」。 在 vibe coding 上他很激进：重写了 Quicken（记账软件）和 Campaign Monitor（邮件营销软件，他原来一年要付约 6.7 万美元，还因为按「总邮件数」而非「去重邮件数」计费而被坑）。他用 Python、不碰 React/Next，因为他不想当任何东西的系统管理员——软件「就该正常工作」。关键心态：他从「造出能帮他写作、能帮他用新方式发布的软件」里获得能量，这些工具反过来激励他写得更多、办更多 board meeting。 他和 Dan 聊到一个更深的转变：AI 时代「能不能造出来」已经不再是质量的衡量标准了——一个周末就能 spin up 一家公司，大家只会耸耸肩说「所以呢？」。新的衡量标准变成了「你有没有长期维护它」。Kevin Kelly 会先给想写的书做封面，往往这个动作就消解了写书的欲望——AI 把这种「是真在做事，还是只是拥有了做过事的表象」的检验加速了。对 Greg，造软件必须回喂到更大的目的（写作），而不是为造而造、空转轮子。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq flagged a mental-model update for software engineering: rewrites can now be good, cheap, and fast. Conventional wisdom said "don't rewrite, refactor" — but that premise is loosening in the AI-coding era. Using Bun as an example, he notes most apps aren't as testable and verifiable as Bun, but models will keep filling those gaps. For consulting and enterprise contexts, the default assumption that "legacy systems can only be patched" deserves reexamination.
items.insightZh: Thariq 指出一个应该更新你「软件工程心智模型」的观点：重写（rewrite）现在可以又好、又便宜、又快。传统智慧一直是「不要重写、要重构」，但在 AI 编码时代这个前提松动了。他以 Bun 为例——当然大多数应用不像 Bun 那样可测试、可验证，但随着模型越来越强，它们会持续把这些空白补上。对咨询和企业落地场景来说，这意味着「遗留系统只能修修补补」的默认假设需要重新评估。

items.title: Nan Yu · Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu shared a sharp product-marketing lesson: you're writing a story to transmit to your audience, but also for your audience to transmit to theirs. He mapped the chain — PMM to Sales to Customer; PMM to Customer to Peer; PMM to User to Buyer; PMM to Champion to Org. The core insight: good messaging must be re-transmittable, because the real spread happens when you're not in the room. Directly relevant to B2B narrative-building.
items.insightZh: Nan Yu 讲了一个精辟的产品营销（PMM）课：你写故事不只是为了传递给你的受众，更是为了让你的受众能把它转述给他们的受众。他画出了传播链条——PMM 传给销售、销售传给客户；PMM 传给客户、客户传给同行；PMM 传给用户、用户传给采购决策者；PMM 传给内部拥护者、拥护者传给整个组织。核心洞察是：好的信息必须「可转述」，因为真正的扩散发生在你不在场的时候。这对 B2B 咨询做方案叙事很有借鉴意义。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie observed the latest AI models are getting insanely good at complex knowledge-worker tasks, especially sophisticated domains like legal, professional services, and healthcare. He named Grok 4.5 as another strong entry, particularly on cost + performance. His bigger call: as models improve at coding, math, and reasoning — and get trained on key verticals — we'll see more leaps in what's possible with enterprise data and documents. A directly relevant signal for professional-services firms.
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 观察到最新一批 AI 模型在处理复杂知识工作任务上「好得离谱」，尤其是在法律、专业服务、医疗等高度专业化领域。他点名 Grok 4.5 是这方面又一个不错的选择，特别是成本和性能的平衡。他的更大判断：随着模型在编码、数学、推理上大幅提升，并且在各个关键垂直领域被训练，我们会看到「用企业数据和文档能做的事」出现更多飞跃。对埃森哲这类专业服务机构，这是直接相关的信号——垂直领域的深水区正在被模型攻克。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 合伙人、Dropbox 前 CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya issued a forceful call to founders: don't waste the moment, be maximally ambitious. Every founder worries about missing this AI moment, but the best worry about wasting it — and there's a difference. It's a waste to ignore how much the world changed, to think you can capture value with pure software like 5 years ago, or to build something small. For South Park Commons' Founder Fellowship he wants hardware tinkerers, mad scientists, obsessives, biohackers. His zinger: "If you're only building software, pleas…
items.insightZh: Aditya 对创始人发出一记有力的号召：不要浪费这个时刻，要「最大化地雄心勃勃」。他说每个他见到的创始人都担心错过这个 AI 时刻，但最好的那批人担心的是「浪费」它——两者有区别。浪费，是无视世界已经发生的巨变；是以为还能像五年前一样靠纯软件捕获价值；是只做一件小事。他为 South Park Commons 的 Founder Fellowship 招募的是：硬件极客、疯狂科学家、偏执狂、生物黑客、在地下室造核反应堆的人。他的锐评：「如果你只做软件，那么（为你自己好）请至少有一个让所有朋友嘲笑你的论点。异端是雄心的代价。」

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw / OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger clarified something the ecosystem was watching: OpenAI hired him, not OpenClaw. The OpenClaw Foundation stays independent, with sponsors rather than owners, and — for the first time — a full-time team keeping the project alive and stable. For anyone tracking open-source agent governance, this settles the "does hiring the founder mean absorbing the project" question: governance stays independent.
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 澄清了一件行业内关注的事：OpenAI 招聘的是他本人，而不是 OpenClaw。OpenClaw Foundation 是独立的，采用赞助商（sponsor）而非所有者（owner）的模式，并且第一次有了一个全职团队来保持这个项目的存活和稳定。对关注开源 agent 生态的人，这澄清了「大厂招人是否等于收编项目」的疑虑——项目治理保持独立。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Guillermo Rauch made a bold prediction: AI will make all software Native — uncompromising performance and platform affinity. The logic: when writing code approaches zero cost, per-platform native optimization stops being a luxury. Vercel also opened Grok 4.5 to all customers. The signal points to a trend: the era of cross-platform compromise (one codebase for all, to save cost) may be reversed by AI.
items.insightZh: Guillermo Rauch 抛出一个大胆预言：AI 会让所有软件都「原生化」（Native）——无妥协的性能和平台亲和性。他的逻辑是，当写代码的成本趋近于零，为每个平台单独做原生优化不再是奢侈品。同时 Vercel 已把 Grok 4.5 开放给所有客户使用。这条信号指向一个趋势：跨平台妥协（为省成本用一套代码通吃）的时代可能被 AI 逆转。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad Masad posed a provocative question: when do we stop comparing autonomous agents to hand-written code? His analogy — you don't see compilers being compared to engineers hand-writing assembly. The subtext: agent-generated code is becoming a new abstraction layer, like high-level languages replaced assembly, and the "agent code isn't as good as hand-written" comparison will eventually feel dated. A useful frame for when to trust agent deliverables.
items.insightZh: Amjad Masad 抛出一个挑衅性的问题：我们什么时候才能停止拿自主 agent 和手写代码作比较？他类比说——你不会看到编译器去跟「手写汇编的工程师」比较。这句话的潜台词是：agent 生成代码正在成为新的抽象层，就像高级语言取代汇编一样，「agent 写的代码不如人手写」这种比较终将过时。对企业技术决策者，这是一个关于「何时该信任 agent 交付物」的心智框架。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj flagged a counterintuitive trend: "polished" is getting correlated with slop faster than you'd imagine, and he predicts a major reversion to raw and human. When AI mass-produces glossy content, rough and authentically human work becomes the scarce signal. He also mused on the developer pendulum between Codex and Claude Code — "we're so dead / we're back again" every week — and enjoys the two teams pushing each other as a neutral.
items.insightZh: Nikunj 观察到一个反直觉的趋势：「精致」正在以你想象不到的速度和「slop（AI 垃圾内容）」画上等号。他预测我们会看到一次向「原始、有人味」的大回归。这背后是一个审美和信任的转向——当 AI 能批量生产光鲜内容时，粗糙、真实、带人类痕迹的东西反而变成稀缺信号。他还顺带感慨 Codex 和 Claude Code 之间开发者的钟摆式迁移「每周都在上演——我们要完了 / 我们又回来了」，作为中立者很享受两个团队互相push。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx shared an observation on design conveying humanity: in a world of Claude-slopped, thin-color-border "professional" slides, Theo's keynote went for the hand-drawn Excalidraw/tldraw look — immediately conveying humanity, thoughtfulness, and parsimonious concision over badly-rewarded verbosity. A signal for presentation and brand people: as AI flattens all "professional look," hand-drawn feel and deliberate restraint become differentiators.
items.insightZh: Swyx 分享了一个关于「设计传递人味」的观察：在一个满是「Claude 味、细色边框、看起来很专业」的幻灯片世界里，Theo 的 keynote 却选了 Excalidraw / tldraw 那种手绘风格——这立刻传递出人味、深思熟虑、以及「精简克制胜过被错误奖励的冗长」。这条 signal 对做演示和品牌的人有启发：在 AI 抹平一切「专业外观」的时代，手绘感和刻意的克制成了差异化的信号。

sections.description: 工程博客与长文，关注能力边界、复盘和落地经验。

items.title: Claude Code 质量下降事件复盘
items.summaryEn: Over the past month, users reported Claude got worse; Anthropic traced it to three separate changes affecting different traffic slices, whose aggregate looked like broad, inconsistent degradation. The API was never affected; all three were fixed by April 20. Three root causes: (1) On March 4, the default reasoning effort dropped from high to medium to cut "UI-appears-frozen" latency — the wrong tradeoff, reverted April 7. (2) On March 26, a change to clear idle sessions' old thinking had a bug making it clear every turn, making Claude seem forgetful and repetitive — fixed April 10. (3) On April 16, a verbosity-reducing system prompt combined with other changes hurt coding quality — reverted April 20. Because each hit different traffic on different schedules, the aggregate looked like broad degradation. Anthropic admitted these were hard to distinguish from normal feedback variation, and…
items.insightZh: 过去一个月用户反馈 Claude 变差，Anthropic 追查到三个独立的、影响不同流量切片的改动叠加在一起，造成了「看起来广泛而不一致的退化」——API 未受影响，三个问题在 4 月 20 日全部修复。 三个根因：(1) 3 月 4 日把 Claude Code 默认推理强度从 high 降到 medium，为了减少「UI 看起来卡死」的超长延迟——但这是个错误的权衡，4 月 7 日回滚（影响 Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6）；(2) 3 月 26 日上线一个改动，清理闲置超一小时会话的旧 thinking 来降延迟，结果一个 bug 让它在整个会话里每轮都清一次，导致 Claude 显得健忘、重复，4 月 10 日修复；(3) 4 月 16 日加了一条「减少冗长」的系统提示，与其他 prompt 改动叠加后损害了编码质量，4 月 20 日回滚（影响 Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 / Opus 4.7）。因为每个改动影响不同流量、时间线不同，聚合起来就像大范围退化。Anthropic 承认早期难以把这些和正常反馈波动区分开，内部 eval 一开始也没复现。作为补偿，4 月 23 日为所有订阅用户重置了用量限制。

items.title: Scaling Managed Agents：把「大脑」和「双手」解耦
items.summaryEn: Anthropic split long-horizon agents into three independently replaceable interfaces — session (append-only event log), harness (the loop calling Claude and routing tool calls), and sandbox (execution environment) — much like operating systems once virtualized hardware into process/file abstractions, so implementations can swap freely. Core argument: harnesses encode assumptions about what Claude can't do alone, but those go stale as models improve. Example: Sonnet 4.5 wrapped up tasks prematurely sensing its context limit ("context anxiety"), fixed via harness context resets — but on Opus 4.5 the behavior was gone and resets became dead weight. So they built Managed Agents, a hosted service running long-horizon agents through interfaces meant to outlast any implementation. Initially everything lived in one container — the "pet" trap: if it failed, the session was lost, and debugging was…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 把长时程 agent 拆成 session（只追加的事件日志）、harness（调用 Claude、路由工具调用的循环）、sandbox（执行环境）三个可独立替换的接口——像操作系统当年把硬件虚拟化成 process / file 抽象一样，让实现可以随意替换而不影响其他部分。 核心论点：harness（agent 脚手架）里编码了「Claude 自己做不到什么」的假设，但这些假设会随模型变强而过时。举例：Claude Sonnet 4.5 会因为感到 context 快满了而过早收尾任务（被称为「context anxiety」），他们在 harness 里加了 context reset 来解决；但换到 Opus 4.5 上，这个行为消失了，reset 反而成了死重。所以他们造了 Managed Agents——一个托管服务，通过「一组意在比任何具体实现活得更久」的接口来运行长时程 agent。最初他们把所有组件塞进单个容器，结果踩了「养宠物（pet）」的坑：容器一挂 session 就没了，调试时还因为容器里混着用户数据而无从下手。解决方案就是把「大脑」（Claude + harness）从「双手」（sandbox + 工具）和「session」（事件日志）里解耦，每个都成为对彼此假设极少的接口，可以各自失败、各自替换。

items.title: Managed Agents 新功能：自托管 sandbox 与 MCP 隧道
items.summaryEn: Claude Managed Agents can now run in a sandbox you control and connect to your private MCP servers — both the tool-execution sandbox and the services it reaches stay within your enterprise's security and runtime boundaries, so sensitive files and repos never leave your network. Self-hosted sandboxes (public beta) keep sensitive files, packages, and services on your own infrastructure — or with managed providers Cloudflare / Daytona / Modal / Vercel handling compute and isolation. The agent loop (orchestration, context management, error recovery) stays on Anthropic's side; tool execution moves to your configured environment. Bring any sandbox client or start with supported ones: Cloudflare (microVMs + light isolates, zero-trust auditable egress), Daytona (composable, long-running, pause/restore with full state), Modal (sub-second startup, scales to hundreds of thousands concurrent), Verc…
items.insightZh: Claude Managed Agents 现在可以在你自己控制的 sandbox 里运行、连接你私有的 MCP 服务器——agent 执行工具的 sandbox 和它访问的服务都留在企业既有的安全和运行时边界内，敏感文件和代码库不出内网。 自托管 sandbox（公测中）让你把敏感文件、依赖、服务留在自己的基础设施上，或交给 Cloudflare / Daytona / Modal / Vercel 这类托管方处理算力和隔离；负责编排、context 管理、错误恢复的 agent loop 仍留在 Anthropic 侧，工具执行则搬到你配置的环境里。你可以自带 sandbox 客户端，也可以从支持的几家起步——Cloudflare（用 microVM + 轻量 isolate，出站请求可零信任审计/改写）、Daytona（可完整组合、长时运行、可暂停恢复保留完整状态）、Modal（子秒级启动、可扩到几十万并发）、Vercel（VM 级安全 + VPC peering + 毫秒级启动，凭据在网络边界注入，从不进 sandbox）。MCP 隧道（研究预览中）让 agent 能连到你私有网络里的 MCP 服务器而无需暴露到公网——你部署一个轻量网关，只做一条出站连接，无需入站防火墙规则、无公网端点、流量端到端加密。内部数据库、私有 API、知识库、工单系统都能变成 agent 可调用的工具。对有严格数据合规要求的企业（金融、医疗、专业服务），这是把 agent 能力引入内网而不破坏安全边界的关键一步。
